notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Omen Hawker.
Omen Hawker does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Omen Hawker by tapping it, adding {C}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Omen Hawker.
Repeat.
